originals.IncludeNullableInBounds:
Private Shared Sub IncludeNullableInBounds(value As Nullable(Of Double),
                                                   ByRef minimum As Double,
                                                   ByRef maximum As Double)
            If Not value.HasValue Then Return
            If value.Value < minimum Then minimum = value.Value
            If value.Value > maximum Then maximum = value.Value
        End Sub
originals.AddConstantReferenceLine:
Private Shared Sub AddConstantReferenceLine(
            chart As Chart,
            name As String,
            categories As Object(),
            value As Double,
            color As Integer,
            lineWeight As Single,
            dashStyle As Integer,
            options As SpcControlChartAppearanceOptions)

            Dim values(categories.Length - 1) As Object
            For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
                values(i) = value
            Next
            AddReferenceLine(chart,
                             name,
                             categories,
                             values,
                             color,
                             lineWeight,
                             dashStyle,
                             options.ShowLimitLabels,
                             options)
        End Sub
originals.AddCharts:
Public Shared Function AddCharts(
            worksheet As Worksheet,
            result As SpcFitResult,
            Optional appearance As SpcControlChartAppearanceOptions = Nothing) As Chart()

            Return AddCharts(worksheet, result, appearance, Nothing)
        End Function

adaptation: Typed numerical extent return replaces private ByRef updates; original Object boxing of constant Double becomes a fresh Double vector and stays host-marshalled. Existing panel top expression is unchanged. No channel/stage/zone logic moved.
functions:
Public Function SpcOptionalExtent(value As Nullable(Of Double), minimum As Double, maximum As Double) As ChartAxisScaleResult
If Not value.HasValue Then Return New ChartAxisScaleResult(minimum,maximum,0.0R)
If value.Value < minimum Then minimum = value.Value
If value.Value > maximum Then maximum = value.Value
Return New ChartAxisScaleResult(minimum,maximum,0.0R)
End Function
Public Function SpcConstantReference(count As Integer, value As Double) As Double()
Dim values(count - 1) As Double
For i As Integer = 0 To values.Length - 1
values(i) = value
Next
Return values
End Function
Public Function SpcPanelTop(top As Double, panelIndex As Integer, panelHeight As Double, panelSpacing As Double) As Double
Return top + panelIndex * (panelHeight + panelSpacing)
End Function
